privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Kalorie is free and has no ads. This is what it keeps about you, in plain words.

phone.title: On your phone
phone.body: Everything you log — food, goals, weight, water, recipes, thalis and label photos — is saved on this phone. You don't need an account for any of it.

account.title: If you sign in
account.body: We keep your email address, so we can send you a sign-in code. Nothing else leaves your phone, except foods you choose to share with a group. When backup arrives in a later update, a copy of your log will be kept with your account too — this page will say so first.

where.title: Where it is kept
where.body: Accounts are kept by Supabase, on servers in Mumbai, India. Each account can open only its own data, and a group's foods can be seen only by the people in that group: the database itself checks this on every request.

group.title: If you join a group
group.body: The people in your group see the group's name, the name you give yourself in it, and the foods you choose to share: name, brand, barcode, nutrients and portion sizes. Your log, your weight, your goals and your label photos are never shared. When you leave, the foods you shared leave with you.

sold.title: Never sold
sold.body: Your data is never sold, never shared with advertisers and never used for ads. There are no ads, and no tracking or analytics tools inside the app.

barcode.title: Barcode lookups
barcode.body: When you scan a packet, only its barcode number is sent to Open Food Facts to find the product. Nothing about you goes with it.

delete.title: Deleting
delete.body: Profile → Account → Delete my account and data removes your account and everything kept online for it, at once. To remove what is on your phone, uninstall the app.

group.title: My group
group.intro: A group is a few people — family or friends — who share foods with each other: your recipes and the packets you scanned. Only people in the group can see them.
